evidence: ZrCl used was of 99.5% purity. The vapor pressure of ZrCl was controlled by the choice of the source temperature (T ). Distilled and de-ionized water was used as a source of H O vapor while aqueous solution of H O (35%) was applied as a source of H O . In the latter case, of course, a significant amount of H O was also present in the vapor phase. H O and H O were vaporized in a container that was kept at 20 8C. The vapor of oxygen precursor was led into the reactor through a needle valve that allowed the setting of precursor doses.
